roles.title: President
roles.summary: I lead the club: I set its direction and oversee its technical programs. I focus on giving students chances to learn, compete and work on practical problems in AI and data science.

roles.title: Technical Team Member
roles.summary: Co-organized HACKaMINeD 2026, a national hackathon with 1,000+ participants from across India. Helped deliver a two-day workshop on end-to-end machine learning and deep learning for 100+ students.

roles.title: Founding Board Member
roles.summary: Helped found the chapter at Nirma University and shaped its technical direction around agentic AI. Led "Hire Your First Research Agent", a hands-on session for 50+ students on building and automating research workflows with n8n and Google ADK.
